```{mermaid}
flowchart TD
  A(Microbial Profile \nWGX) --> |split by group| B(Microbial Profile \nWGX CASE)
  A(Microbial Profile \nWGX) --> C(Microbial Profile \nWGX CONTROL)
  A(Microbial Profile \nWGX) --> D(Microbial Profile \nWGX OTHER)
  B(Microbial Profile \nWGX CASE) --> |Batch Prevalence filter| E(Taxa Prevalence for: \n--Flowcell Barcodes \n--Sequencing Dates \n--Sequencing centers \n--Cohorts)
  C --> E
  D --> E
  E --> F(Remove Batches with < 25\n Compare max and min \nprevalence across batches)
  F --> G(taxa with a \nmax prev. > 0.5 and > 2x increase \nfrom min batch prev.)


  A(Microbial Profile \nWGX) --> | Read Count \nfilter| I(Taxa with max \nread count < 100)
  I --> Z[(Taxa\nblacklist)]
  A --> |Reagent \ncontaminants| J(Taxa flagged in \nSalter et al. 2014)
  J --> Z
  G --> Z
```

Utility functions

```{r, eval=FALSE}

# Utility functions ----
calculate_batch_prevalence <- function(ps, subset_var) {
    require(magrittr)
    subset_data <- microbiome::meta(ps) %>%
        dplyr::pull(subset_var)
    batches <- subset_data %>% unique()
    prevalence_stats <- tibble::tibble()
    for (batch in batches) {
        print(batch)
        batch_samples <<- grepl(batch, subset_data)
        # skip if there are less than 25 samples
        if (sum(batch_samples) < 25) next
        ps_batch <- phyloseq::subset_samples(ps, batch_samples)
        print(ps_batch)
        batch_stats <- microbiome::prevalence(ps_batch) %>%
            stack() %>%
            dplyr::mutate(
                batch_subset = as.character(batch),
                batch_variable = subset_var,
                sample_n = phyloseq::nsamples(ps_batch)
            )
        prevalence_stats %<>% dplyr::bind_rows(batch_stats)
    }
    return(prevalence_stats)
}

```


Formatting sequencing flowcell / date / center metadata for decontamination

```{r, eval=FALSE}
wgs_sequencing_meta <- readRDS(
  glue(
    "{wkdir}/data/interim/metadata/",
    "2022-12-31_sequencing_metadata.rds"
  )
)
# Platform unit naming convention
# {FLOWCELL_BARCODE}.{LANE}.{SAMPLE_BARCODE}.
# ftp://gatk.broadinstitute.org/hc/en-us/articles/360035890671-Read-groups
wgs_sequencing_meta_formatted <- wgs_sequencing_meta %>%
  mutate(PLATFORM_UNIT = 
  if_else(grepl("LB-", SAMPLE), 
    gsub("_X", ".X", PLATFORM_UNIT) %>% gsub("_E", ".E", .),
    PLATFORM_UNIT)
  ) %>% 
  separate(PLATFORM_UNIT,
    c("FLOWCELL_BARCODE", "SAMPLE_BARCODE", "PLATFORM_UNIT_LANE"),
    sep = "\\.", remove = FALSE
  ) %>%
    mutate(SAMPLE = str_remove(SAMPLE, "SM:"))

meta_freq <-
  colnames(wgs_sequencing_meta_formatted) %>%
  purrr::map(
    ~ wgs_sequencing_meta_formatted %>%
      group_by(!!sym(.x)) %>%
      summarize(n = n())
  )

center_info <- wgs_sequencing_meta_formatted %>%
  select(SAMPLE, CENTER) %>%
  distinct()
flowcell_info <- wgs_sequencing_meta_formatted %>%
  get_dupes(FLOWCELL_BARCODE) %>%
  filter(dupe_count >= 25) %>%
  select(SAMPLE, FLOWCELL_BARCODE) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(detected = 1) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = FLOWCELL_BARCODE,
    values_from = detected, values_fill = 0
  )

dates <- wgs_sequencing_meta_formatted$DATE %>% unique

# Adding sequencing data metadata to phyloseq object
meta_wide <- wgs_sequencing_meta_formatted %>%
  get_dupes(DATE) %>%
  filter(dupe_count >= 25) %>%
  select(SAMPLE, DATE) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(detected = 1) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = DATE, values_from = detected, values_fill = 0) %>%
  dplyr::full_join(flowcell_info, by = "SAMPLE") %>%
  dplyr::full_join(center_info, by = "SAMPLE") %>%
  dplyr::rename(participant_id = SAMPLE) %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  mutate_if(is.numeric, as.logical) %>%
  mutate_if(is.logical, ~ replace_na(., FALSE))
date_timepoints <- meta_wide %>%
  select_if(is.logical) %>%
  select(contains("dt_")) %>% 
  colnames()
flowcell_barcodes <- meta_wide %>%
  select_if(is.logical) %>%
  select(contains("pu_")) %>% 
  colnames()

batch_meta <- c(
    "study",
    "center",
    date_timepoints,
    flowcell_barcodes
)

```

### Calculating Batch Prevalence statistics

**Decontaminaton procedure** 

- Iterate over cohort / flow cell / and sequencing date and extract samples which have only been run in a single run (check to see if this means we lose any cohorts or flowcells)

- Then, calculate prevalence for each in-group / out-group sample set



```{r, eval=FALSE}

# Function take subsets of samples from a phyloseq object and return a
# dataframe with prevalence stats on a per-feature basis for within and
# without subset groups
# filter samples by cohort
# Sequencing date
# Sequencing center
# Flowcell barcode

# Load phyloseq object
ps <- readRDS(
  glue(
    "data/processed/phyloseq_objects/raw/",
    "2023-10-19_WGS_KrakenUnique_phyloseq.rds"
  )
)

# add sequencing metadata to phyloseq object
meta <- ps %>% meta()
meta_seq <- meta %>%
    dplyr::left_join(meta_wide, by = "participant_id") %>%
    mutate_if(is.logical, ~ replace_na(., FALSE))
rownames(meta_seq) <- meta_seq$participant_id
sample_data(ps) <- phyloseq::sample_data(meta_seq)

# Prevalence filter
ps_groups <- c(
    "Case" = phyloseq::subset_samples(
        ps,
        case_control_other_latest == "Case"
    ),
    "Control" = phyloseq::subset_samples(
        ps,
        case_control_other_latest == "Control"
    ),
    "Other" = phyloseq::subset_samples(
        ps,
        case_control_other_latest == "Other"
    )
)

# all possible combos of an x var and a y var
pair_combos <- expand_grid(
    ps_list = names(ps_groups),
    var_list = batch_meta
) %>%
    mutate(batch_id = glue("{ps_list}_{var_list}"))
ps_list <- pair_combos$ps_list
var_list <- pair_combos$var_list
names(ps_list) <- pair_combos$batch_id

tic()
future::plan("multisession", workers = 8)
prevalence_stats <- furrr::future_map2(
    ps_list,
    var_list,
    ~ calculate_batch_prevalence(ps_groups[[.x]], .y)
) %>%
    bind_rows(.id = "grouping_meta")

toc()

# Select features with a max of at least 25% prevalence and
# a minimum of < 2x for other batches
prevalence_stats_proc <- prevalence_stats %>%
    filter(batch_subset != "FALSE") %>%
    mutate(batch_subset = case_when(
        grepl("dt_|pu_", batch_variable) ~ batch_variable,
        TRUE ~ batch_subset
    ), batch_variable = case_when(
        grepl("dt_", batch_variable) ~ "date",
        grepl("pu_", batch_variable) ~ "flowcell_barcode",
        TRUE ~ batch_variable
    )) %>%
    mutate(case_control_other_latest = strex::str_before_first(
        grouping_meta, "_"
    ))

# flag microbes that are present in at least 50% of samples in at least
# one batch and are at least 2x more abundant in
# that batch than in any other
blacklist_prev <- prevalence_stat_summary %>%
    filter(max > 0.5, min <= max / 2) %>%
    arrange(desc(prevalence_delta)) %>%
    pull(ind) %>%
    unique()

saveRDS(
    prevalence_stats_proc,
    glue(
        "{wkdir}/data/interim/decontamination/",
        "{Sys.Date()}_WGS_KrakenUnique_prevalence_stats.rds"
    )
)
saveRDS(
    blacklist_prev,
    glue(
        "{wkdir}/data/interim/decontamination/",
        "{Sys.Date()}_WGS_KrakenUnique_prevalence_blacklist.rds"
    )
)

```

Visualizing prevalence stats

```{r, eval=FALSE}

prevalence_stats_proc <- readRDS(
    glue(
        "{wkdir}/data/interim/decontamination/",
        "2023-10-19_WGS_KrakenUnique_prevalence_stats.rds"
    )
)
blacklist_prev <- readRDS(
    glue(
        "{wkdir}/data/interim/decontamination/",
        "2023-10-19_WGS_KrakenUnique_prevalence_blacklist.rds"
    )
)

prevalence_stat_summary <- prevalence_stats_proc %>%
    # remove batches with fewer than 25 samples
    filter(sample_n > 25) %>%
    # check that all batches have at least a min and a max
    get_dupes(ind, batch_variable, case_control_other_latest) %>%
    filter(dupe_count > 1) %>%
    # summarize the min and max prevalence for each microbe
    group_by(ind, batch_variable, case_control_other_latest) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
        min = min(values), max = max(values),
        prevalence_delta = max - min
    ) %>%
    glimpse()

plot_df <- prevalence_stat_summary %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(ind = as.character(ind)) %>%
    mutate(blacklist = purrr::map_lgl(ind,  ~ . %in% blacklist_prev)) %>%
    arrange(blacklist, desc(prevalence_delta)) %>%
    mutate(ind = factor(ind))

p1 <- plot_df %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = ind, y = prevalence_delta, color = blacklist)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 0.5) +
    scale_color_d3() +
    facet_grid(batch_variable ~ case_control_other_latest) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(x = "microbe", y = "max prevalence - min prevalence") +
        theme(axis.text.x = element_blank())

# How does blacklist detection compare across groups
p2 <- plot_df %>%
    ggplot(aes(
    x = case_control_other_latest,
    y = prevalence_delta,
    color = blacklist
    )) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.3) +
    geom_line(aes(group = ind), alpha = 0.3, linewidth = 0.3) +
    facet_wrap(~batch_variable, ncol = 1) +
    scale_color_d3() +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position='none')

final_plot <- p1 %>% insert_right(p2, width = 0.5)
ggsave(
    glue(
        "{wkdir}/figures/decontamination/",
        "{Sys.Date()}_WGS_KrakenUnique_prevalence_filter_EDA.png"
    ),
    final_plot,
    width = 12, height = 10
)

```

### Read Count Filter
Flagging taxa with a max read count below 100 across all 9,833 samples for removal

```{r, eval=FALSE}
# Read count filter ----
blacklist_readcounts <-
    filter_taxa(ps, function(x) max(x) < 100, TRUE) %>%
    taxa()
saveRDS(
    blacklist_readcounts,
    glue(
        "{wkdir}/data/interim/decontamination/",
        "{Sys.Date()}_WGS_KrakenUnique",
        "_blacklist_readcounts.rds"
    )
)

```


### Reagent contaminants [Salter et al. 2014](https://link.springer.com/article/10.1186/s12915-014-0087-z)

This section aggregates genera-level taxa identifed from Salter et. al, and annotates them with NCBI lineage information. We then expand this genera-level list across the Family to Strain clades. Taxa here are flagged for removal.

```{r, eval=FALSE}

# Annotating taxa with NCBI lineage information
ncbi_lineages <- read.delim(
  glue(
    "/central/groups/MazmanianLab/joeB/Downloads/",
    "2023-08-02_ncbi-taxdump/fullnamelineage.dmp"
  ),
  quote = "",
  header = FALSE
) %>%
  select(-c(V2, V4, V6)) %>%
      dplyr::rename(taxid = V1, name = V3, lineage = V5) %>%
      mutate(lineage = case_when(
          grepl("Viruses", lineage) ~ paste0("Viruses; ", lineage),
          TRUE ~ lineage
      )) %>%
  glimpse

# mapping taxids to NCBI lineages to get an extensive list of contaminant taxa 
# ranging from the Family -> Strain level

contaminant_genera_lineages <- ncbi_lineages %>%
  filter(taxid %in% contaminant_genera_blacklist) %>%
  pull(lineage)

# filter lineages of contaminant genera using taxids and names
contaminant_lineages <- ncbi_lineages %>%
  mutate(contaminant_lineage = purrr::map_lgl(
    lineage,
    ~ . %in% contaminant_genera_lineages
  )) %>%
  mutate(genera_found = map_lgl(.x = lineage, 
    ~any(str_detect(.x, paste(names(contaminant_genera_blacklist), collapse = "|") )))) %>%
  filter(
    contaminant_lineage | 
    genera_found) %>%
  glimpse


# making sure all contaminant genera taxid's are in NCBI table
all(unlist(contaminant_genera_blacklist) %in% contaminant_lineages$taxid)

saveRDS(
  contaminant_lineages,
  glue(
    "{wkdir}/data/interim/decontamination/",
    "{Sys.Date()}_reagent_blacklist_contaminant_lineages.rds"
  )
)

```

Assembling blacklists.

```{r, eval=FALSE}
blacklist_readcounts <- readRDS(
  glue(
    "{wkdir}/data/interim/decontamination/",
    "2023-10-19_WGS_KrakenUnique_blacklist_readcounts.rds"
  )
)
blacklist_prev <- readRDS(
    glue(
        "{wkdir}/data/interim/decontamination/",
        "2023-10-19_WGS_KrakenUnique_prevalence_blacklist.rds"
    )
) %>% as.character()

contaminant_lineages <- readRDS(
  glue(
    "{wkdir}/data/interim/decontamination/",
    "2024-02-25_reagent_blacklist_contaminant_lineages.rds"
  )
)
final_blacklist <- c(
  blacklist_prev,
  blacklist_readcounts,
  contaminant_lineages$taxid
) %>%
  unique()

# Annotating taxa with NCBI lineage information
ncbi_lineages <- read.delim(
  glue(
    "/central/groups/MazmanianLab/joeB/Downloads/",
    "2023-08-02_ncbi-taxdump/fullnamelineage.dmp"
  ),
  quote = "",
  header = FALSE
) %>%
  select(-c(V2, V4, V6)) %>%
    dplyr::rename(taxid = V1, name = V3, lineage = V5) %>%
    mutate(lineage = case_when(
      grepl("Viruses", lineage) ~ paste0("Viruses; ", lineage),
      TRUE ~ lineage
    ))

kraken_uniq_results_df <- readRDS(
  glue(
    "{wkdir}/data/interim/kraken_results/",
    "2023-10-15_WGS_KrakenUniq_results.rds"
  )
)
kuq <- kraken_uniq_results_df %>%
    dplyr::rename(taxid = taxID) %>%
    left_join(ncbi_lineages, by = "taxid")

kuq_decon <- kuq %>%
  # fitler human, vector, and unmapped reads
  filter(
    !is.na(lineage) & lineage != ""
  ) %>% 
  filter(
    !grepl("cellular organisms; Eukaryota;", lineage) &
        name != "Eukaryota" & taxName != "other sequences"
  ) %>%
    # filter blacklisted taxa
  filter(taxid %nin% final_blacklist)

# Saving annotated Kraken Tables
saveRDS(
    kuq, glue(
        "{wkdir}/data/interim/kraken_results/",
        "{Sys.Date()}_WGS_KrakenUniq_results_with_lineage.rds"
    )
)
saveRDS(
    kuq_decon, glue(
        "{wkdir}/data/interim/kraken_results/",
        "{Sys.Date()}_WGS_KrakenUniq_results_with_lineage_decon.rds"
    )
)

```

Visualizing a venn diagram of taxa flagged for removal across methods

```{r, eval=FALSE}
library(VennDiagram)
# Load phyloseq object
ps <- readRDS(
  glue(
    "data/processed/phyloseq_objects/raw/",
    "2023-10-19_WGS_KrakenUnique_phyloseq.rds"
  )
)
# Create a named list for the Venn diagram
venn_input <- list(
  Set1 = blacklist_readcounts,
  Set2 = blacklist_prev, 
  Set3 = taxa_names(ps)[(contaminant_lineages$taxid %in% taxa_names(ps))] %>% 
    unique() %>% 
    discard(is.na)
)

# Generate the Venn diagram
venn.plot <- venn.diagram(
  x = venn_input,
  category.names = c(
    "Abundance filter",
    "Prevalence filter",
    "Reagent contaminants"
  ),
  output = TRUE,
  filename = glue(
    "{wkdir}/figures/decontamination/",
    "{Sys.Date()}_blacklist_venn.png"
  ),
  imagetype = "png",
  height = 480*3, width = 480*3, resolution = 300,
  compression = "lzw",
  lwd = 1, col = "black",
  fill = c("#e41a1c", "#377eb8", "#4daf4a"),
  alpha = 0,
  label.col = "black",
  cex = 1.5, fontfamily = "sans", fontface = "plain",
  cat.cex = 1.5, cat.col = "black",
  cat.fontfamily = "sans",
  cat.default.pos = "outer",
  cat.pos = c(-27, 27, 135),
  rotation.degree = 0,
  margin = 0.06
)
# Show the plot
grid.draw(venn.plot)
```
